question: 食品生鲜下哪个商品销量最高
gold_sql: select p.product_name from order_items oi join products p on oi.product_id = p.product_id join categories c on p.category_id = c.category_id join orders o on oi.order_id = o.order_id where c.category_name = '食品生鲜' AND o.status = '已完成' group by p.product_name order by sum(oi.quantity) desc limit 1
raw_output:
SELECT p.product_name, SUM(oi.quantity) AS total_quantity
FROM products p
JOIN order_items oi ON p.product_id = oi.product_id
JOIN categories c ON p.category_id = c.category_id
WHERE c.category_name = '食品生鲜'
GROUP BY p.product_id, p.product_name
ORDER BY total_quantity DESC
LIMIT 1;
pred_sql:
